messages:
maria (sec-eng): heads-up: we just got CVE-2026-0456 flagged by vuln intel. upstream says patch available but it requires glibc bump and a kernel-compatible rebuild. affects our on-prem/dedicated images. need triage and backport plan.
raj (eng-infra): can you paste the vuln summary / exploit maturity?
maria (sec-eng): CVSS 8.2, public PoC from 48h ago, privilege escalation vector in userland, vendor released fix in latest distro packages. exploit seems reliable in lab.
lin (private-deploy): for our Private images some customers run RHEL7-based appliances, others use Ubuntu 18.04. RHEL7 is EOL for many distros — backport option might be non-trivial.
jonathan (oncall): high risk for on-prem customers without rapid patching. we should classify as P1 for Dedicated/Private unless customer images already pinned to immutable kernels.
raj (eng-infra): options: (A) rebuild base images with patched glibc + kernel compat flags, push as new customer-specific image tags; (B) produce offline patch bundle for air-gapped installs (rpm/deb + scripts); (C) provide mitigation docs (sysctl/workarounds) while we build images.
sasha (customer-ops): several enterprise customers requested no auto-pull of images, they expect signed bundles. We'll need to coordinate signed offline artifacts and advisories.
maria (sec-eng): KMS note: some customers use our KMS integration in private mode (HSM/KMS). if we ship new images we must ensure key agent and kms plugins remain compatible. verify openssl / libcrypto ABI changes.
raj (eng-infra): good call. glibc rebuild could change symbols; we'll run integration tests against KMS agent + HSM mock. allocate CI matrix: rhel7/rhel8/ubuntu18.04/20.04.
lin (private-deploy): air-gapped flow: generate an offline bundle tar.gz that contains image tar, signed manifest, digest + install script. customers can validate signature using our root cert. Need QA on install script for strict SELinux/iptables rules.
jonathan (oncall): add audit logging checklist: after patch, ensure syscall audit rules still capture relevant events, and that our log rotation doesn't drop audit logs during rebuild. Also confirm RBAC changes (if any) are documented.
maria (sec-eng): prioritization suggestion: 1) Dedicated (hosted dedicated pools) — auto rollout with canary + fallback within 48h; 2) Private customers on supported OS (rhel8/ubuntu20.04) — provide image + signed bundle within 7 days; 3) Older/custom images (rhel7/ubuntu18.04) — produce targeted backports or mitigation docs, ETA 14 days. Comments?
sasha (customer-ops): timeline workable, but we must notify affected customers before canary for Dedicated and give scheduled maintenance windows for Private. I can draft comms.
raj (eng-infra): technical blockers: kernel modules we ship in some images need recompilation. also our CI doesn't currently build rhel7 kernels in prod. will take extra effort.
maria (sec-eng): action items: (1) raj — start CI matrix + reproducible build plan (rhel7/rhel8/ubuntu18.04/20.04) (2) lin — create offline bundle template and test install script (3) jonathan — audit logging regression tests & RBAC docs (4) sasha — customer comms draft + signature verification instructions. Please add time estimates.
raj (eng-infra): estimate: rhel8/ubuntu20.04 image rebuild + tests 48h. rhel7 backport + kernel module compiles 5d. offline bundle build infra 24h.
lin (private-deploy): estimate: offline bundle template + signed manifest support 36h, test on one reference customer VM 24h.
jonathan (oncall): audit + RBAC test plan 24-36h. will need access to one private deployment staging.
sasha (customer-ops): I'll start comms and list affected customers today. will ask for maintenance windows and indicate signed offline bundles.
deploy-bot: hotfix branch created: release/hotfix/CVE-2026-0456 by raj — CI queued.
maria (sec-eng): thanks. I'll run a quick security review of the changes and sign off on the rollout policy. remember: for customers requiring FIPS/HSM we must not change crypto provider paths without explicit validation.
raj (eng-infra): noted. I'll attach a checklist to the PR: glibc ABI check, libcrypto sanity tests, kms-agent smoke tests, kernel module rebuild log.
lin (private-deploy): one more constraint — some customers keep images in private registries with strict tag schemas. we'll produce both semantic tags and a compatibility manifest that maps old tags to patched images.
maria (sec-eng): good. let's reconvene tomorrow 10:30am PT with status. if PoC spread increases we'll accelerate canary to hosted first. :exclamation:
sasha (customer-ops): copied. I'll post an initial advisory draft to #announcements after we confirm dates.
jonathan (oncall): marking incident board and creating postmortem template in case of active exploit.
maria (sec-eng): closing loop: if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. thanks all.
